messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert for service=az7-serving-pool: high eviction rate detected -> node evictions + control-plane disconnects. Trigger=NIC-flap detector. PD incident #12345 auto-page to eng-oncall.
pagerduty: Page fired to @alice (eng-oncall). Escalation policy: 15m -> ben -> carla. See: https://pd.example/incident/12345
alice: ack — I'm on it. pinging infra and pulling runbook az-zone-eviction. Starting initial triage.
alice: quick check: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep az7` -> 4/12 nodes Ready, rest NotReady. Seeing kubelet evictions in logs.
ben: joining console. checking autoscaler, LB, and cloud instance health.
alice: logs: `/var/log/kubelet.log` shows repeated 'eviction signal: memory.available low' and transient gRPC disconnects to hostagent. Not seeing request surge.
dave: checked infra metrics — NIC error counters spiking on az7 hosts, no significant ingress increase. likely host-level network flaps.
carla: heads-up: Support metrics show hosted-api 5xx rate up ~12% for eu-west (primarily az7). Some customers reporting intermittent 503s.
ben: ok, we should activate regional fallback for new traffic to avoid cascading errors. planning to route new sessions off az7 -> az5,az6. preserving session-affinity where possible.
ben: applying change: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --from=az7 --to=az5,az6 --mode=gradual --batch=1000` — applying now.
incident-bot: Action logged: routing fallback started by ben. Audit id: a1b2c3.
alice: initiating node stabilization: cordon NotReady nodes in az7 and drain where safe to allow rescheduling. Starting targeted instance resets for suspected hosts.
alice: running `gcloud compute instances reset` for 5 instances flagged by NIC error patterns — commands issued.
pagerduty: Reminder: if not acknowledged/escalated in 12m escalate to ben.
ben: nodes are restarting; k8s Ready count climbing: 4 -> 9 -> 11 over ~7 minutes. Good trend.
alice: latency p95 trending down for most routes. Some remaining 502/502s on model-shard-controller calls.
dave: digging into 502s — looks like model-shard-controller RPCs to affected hosts timing out. increasing replica multiplier for the failing model to shed load from problem hosts.
carla: posting incident note to customer status: "Partial degradation affecting eu-west/az7; fallback routing activated; active mitigation underway." Support notified customers with impacted SLA.
alice: handing operational monitoring to ben while I continue infra validations. ben, please take pager.
ben: ack, taking pager and monitoring for 30m before handoff to next shift. Setting PD status to acknowledged (oncall).
incident-bot: PD update: incident #12345 status=acknowledged, mitigation in progress.
ben: all user-facing error rates back near baseline for most endpoints. A small subset of long-lived sessions were dropped; those are being retried client-side.
alice: root cause suspected: host-level NIC packet drops tied to firmware regression; filing cloud provider ticket (CP-7890) with packet captures attached.
carla: assigning postmortem: owners alice (infra) + infra-lead; target draft in 48h.
dave: leaving infra action: confirm firmware rollbacks or host reprovisions; add automatic host NIC monitor to new runbook.
alice: will update once all nodes stable and CP responds. Leaving thread open for final resolve.
carla: thanks team — please annotate timeline & customer comms in the postmortem.
ben: marking incident as mitigated and in monitoring. Will resolve PD once we confirm stability for 30m.
incident-bot: Note: incident remains open until explicit resolve; mitigation flagged.
alice: closing loop for now — initial mitigation successful, no active customer escalations pending. Will post final resolve update in this thread.
